items.title: Generative and agentic AI leadership
items.description: Lead practical use of generative and agentic AI to accelerate research projects: decomposing ambiguous questions into testable workflows, building analysis scaffolds, reviewing model outputs critically, and turning rapid prototypes into reproducible technical work.

items.title: IDeA Labs ethics leadership
items.description: Founded and organized the Modeling the Ethics of Persuasion and Manipulation group in IDeA Labs, creating a research forum for formalizing how influence, incentives, and manipulation can be modeled responsibly.

items.title: RISC 2025 Team NY leadership
items.description: Led Research Team NY during the 2025 RISC-ARLIS Summer Innovation Sprints, coordinating a multidisciplinary GeoINT supply-chain anomaly detection project from problem framing through final presentation.

items.title: Critical analysis
items.description: Experienced in framing and solving complex security questions in cyber-physical systems through mathematical structure.

items.title: Problem solving
items.description: Persistent with open-ended technical challenges that require both theory and implementation.

items.title: Academic excellence
items.description: Published research, conference participation, and strong academic record in computer science and mathematics.

items.title: Team leadership
items.description: Experience coordinating meetings, mentoring, field logistics, and collaborative technical work.

items.title: Professional adaptability
items.description: Experience spanning research, teaching, field data collection, quality review, and seasonal operations.
